testCase.name: [dev] S12 Day 2, failed summary on file: dictation kept, error, Generate disabled; Save Note again succeeds and unlocks Generate; yesterday-only vitals and labs never reach today's note (both modes)

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B05 · P0 · 已知

摘要失败重试后，今天的笔记写进只有昨天才有的数值；摘要不全时显示「✓ Note saved」，昨天的一句话摘要和胸片照常留在面板上，不提示

票：TFA-92592 / TFA-92588 ready for pr · 算 QA bug：否（修复在 PR #100/#101） · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-10/S26

思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S12 「第 2 天，已存了一次失败的摘要：口述保留、有报错、Generate 禁用；再按 Save Note 成功并解锁 Generate；只在昨天有的生命体征和化验绝不进今天的记录（两个模式）」 Day 2, failed summary on file: dictation kept, error, Generate disabled; Save Note again succeeds and unlocks Generate; yesterday-only vitals and labs never reach today's note (both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 8；TFA-94745 state 3；UAT Empty & Failure States）
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af …（TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 AC 5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5）
  • U14 Today's note never includes a vital or lab not refreshed today, and if no vitals were dictated today it says so. Vitals, labs and imaging each show the date they were recorded (dated panels are not o …（UAT 3.7；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident seeded (spec.seed) with yesterday's processed pre-round and panels (20 h old, including fields today's text does not mention) and today's dictation saved by a failed summary (preRoundError set)

When Open each chart: editor, Encounter tab; then Save Note again (the local model answers), look at the panels, go back to Encounter, press Generate Note & Finish and open the note

Then Before the retry: today's dictation is in the box, an explicit error says to tap Save Note to retry, Generate is disabled. After the retry: no error, the panels show today's values and not yesterday's BP, Generate is enabled. Today's note has today's values and none of the yesterday-only temp, O2 or labs (3.7). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs: cp1/cp6 contain today's dictation and an instruction to retry; cp2/cp7 show Generate Note & Finish [disabled]; cp3/cp8 show today's values, not yesterday's BP (150/90, 148/88), no retry message; cp4/cp9 Generate not disabled; cp5/cp10 today's note has today's BP and none of 38.9 / 91% / 3.1 (Hospital) or 38.2 / 5.9 (Nursing Home), per U14. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U66；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 broken 改成 failed。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92588 ready for pr；TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-92592 ready for pr

预查房摘要失败后重试成功，今天生成的笔记仍写进只有昨天才有的数值（医院体温 38.9、血氧 91%、化验 3.1；养老院 38.2、5.9），养老院面板还显示昨天的血压 148/88 且不带日期。

After a failed pre-round summary and a successful retry, today's generated note still contains yesterday-only values (Hospital temp 38.9, O2 91%, lab 3.1; Nursing Home 38.2, 5.9). The Nursing Home panel also shows yesterday's BP 148/88 with no date.

依据：Dev report §2 #2 and ledger #66 (U66), allure c49b4e99. The fix is in open PR #100/#101 (TFA-92592 rework, cluster V). It ran in the rest tier because TFA-92588 is at ready for pr. The failure-state parts pass: dictation kept, the 'tap Save Note' error shows, and Generate stays disabled until the retry.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。

  • (backend): (precondition: the seed holds the failed summary (positive controls are not built)) pass: backend hosp-before preRoundError = "Structured summary update failed"
  • (backend): (precondition: yesterday's panels are seeded) pass: backend hosp-before vitals.bp = "150/90"
  • (backend): (precondition: the seed holds the failed summary (positive controls are not built)) pass: backend res-before preRoundError = "Structured summary update failed"
